paragraphs.text: Incubator is a predefined token and artifact type that debuted in March of the Machine . It is created exclusively through the Incubate mechanic.
Incubators are Phyrexian growth pods used to create new Phyrexian soldiers. They are the front face of a double-faced token card.

When instructed to Incubate N, create an Incubator artifact token with N +1/+1 counters on it. It can be transformed into a 0/0 Phyrexian creature for . The noncreature artifact won't have any use for the +1/+1 counters unless another effect takes place, but due to being true transforming cards, they will be ready to attack the next turn regardless of how many turns it's been a creature.

The cost of to transform is reminiscent of a Clue . Whereas a Clue would add roughly two mana to any spell like a cantrip, an Incubator is generally rated at its size once flipped, minus two mana. The logic is similar regarding Incubating too many times, but with a far smaller number of Incubators, it is less likely to be an issue.
